experiences.subject: Software Developer - Concentric.Al
experiences.preview: Designed and implemented an end-to-end alerting and self-healing system for a service monitoring SMB activity, reducing downtime from 30% to under 5%.
experiences.content: As a Software Developer at Concentric.Al, I designed and implemented an end-to-end alerting and self-healing system for a service monitoring SMB activity, which reduced downtime from 30% to under 5% and improved uptime SLAs. I built scalable support to ingest user activity from NetApp ONTAP file servers using Java and Kubernetes, integrating with the company's data classification pipeline. I also introduced structured metrics and health checks across backend components to enable real-time visibility and faster anomaly detection. Additionally, I transitioned Microsoft OneDrive event handling from a 2-hour batch process to real-time ingestion, reducing lag by over 95%.

projects.name: Alerting & Self-Healing System
projects.description: Designed and implemented an end-to-end alerting and self-healing system for a service monitoring SMB activity. It would check the status fo the kubernetes pod where this service was deployed and proactively enable it if its down. Reduced downtime from 30% to under 5%, improving uptime SLAS.

projects.name: NetApp ONTAP Integration
projects.description: Built scalable support for ingesting user activity from NetApp ONTAP file servers, integrating with the company's unified data classification pipeline.

projects.name: Backend Metrics & Health Checks
projects.description: Introduced structured metrics and health checks across backend components, enabling real-time visibility, early anomaly detection, and faster MTTR.

projects.name: Real-time OneDrive Event Handling
projects.description: Transitioned Microsoft OneDrive event handling from a 2-hour batch process to real-time ingestion using webhook-triggered log pipelines, reducing lag by >95%.

experiences.subject: Software Developer - Yugabyte
experiences.preview: Migrated the Backup/Restore process from a script-based to a controller-based system, reducing the failure rate from over 20% to less than 1% and tripling the speed.
experiences.content: At Yugabyte, I migrated the Backup/Restore process from a script-based to a controller-based system, which made the workflow idempotent. This significantly reduced the backup failure rate from over 20% to under 1% and tripled the process speed. I implemented the incremental backups feature, which reduced backup time and storage needs for customers with large datasets, and added CLI support. I also implemented alerts and monitoring for failed Backup/Restore tasks to allow for faster debugging. Additionally, I developed a feature for PostgreSQL logs to be dumped to a data sink, granting customers access to logs for debugging purposes.

projects.name: Controller-Based Backup/Restore System
projects.description: Migrated the Backup/Restore process from a script-based to a controller-based system, making the workflow idempotent. Also used S3 parallel upload instead of sequential one. This change reduced the failure rate of backups from over 20% to less than 1% and tripled the backup speed.

projects.name: Incremental Backup Feature
projects.description: Added the feature of incremental backups, significantly reducing backup time and storage requirements. This enhancement benefited customers needing frequent backups for large datasets. Additionally, CLI support was implemented.

projects.name: Backup/Restore Monitoring
projects.description: Implemented alerts and monitoring for failed Backup/Restore tasks, enabling faster debugging and resolution of issues.

projects.name: PostgreSQL Log Dumping
projects.description: Added the feature of PostgreSQL logs to be dumped to a data sink. Since this is a fully managed service, customers previously lacked access to logs, making issue debugging challenging.

experiences.subject: Software Developer Engineer - Amazon India
experiences.preview: Created a scalable Data collector to fetch user data for training models, reducing the time from 2 days to 2-3 hours.
experiences.content: At Amazon India, I developed a scalable data collector to fetch user data across various marketplaces for training machine learning models. This new collector reduced the data ingestion time from 2 days to just 2-3 hours. I optimized the team's AWS expenditure, cutting expenses by 60% through scripts that prevented resource leakage and ensured EMR instances were used optimally. Additionally, I automated the entire pipeline for generating an ML model—from data collection and processing to training and production deployment—to predict user network connectivity.

projects.name: Scalable Data Collector
projects.description: Created a scalable Data collector to fetch User data for various marketplaces. This was used to ingest data for training various models. Helped reduce the time from 2 days for a CLI to 2-3 hours.

projects.name: AWS Cost Optimization
projects.description: Optimized the AWS expenditure and wastage for the team. Help reduce the expenses by 60%. Added scripts to ensure there was no resource leakage, and the EMR instances were used optimally.

projects.name: ML Model Automation Pipeline
